primary_anchor_zh: 中央长种植台、两侧连续植物凳和尽头浇水站所构成的整体布局
story_reason_zh: 温室遮帘为调节晨光而缓慢合拢，随后重新打开

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 整间温室在晨光照入的长形温室，保持安静稳定，仅宽叶植物轻微摆动。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 保持安静稳定，仅宽叶植物轻微摆动
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 中央长种植台、两侧连续植物凳和尽头浇水站所构成的整体布局占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 宽大的不透明温室遮帘缓慢合拢并遮住温室内部，画面只留下入口平台
shot_design.main_action_zh: 宽大的不透明温室遮帘缓慢合拢并遮住温室内部，画面只留下入口平台
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 门、屏风或入口帘的开合符合场景用途，动作缓慢，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 温室外侧的空入口平台

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 温室遮帘缓慢打开，重新露出完整温室布局
shot_design.main_action_zh: 温室遮帘缓慢打开，重新露出完整温室布局
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新展示中央长种植台、两侧连续植物凳和尽头浇水站所构成的整体布局，以整体空间关系作为唯一验收目标。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a long planting table along the center aisle, continuous plant benches along the side walls, and a watering station at the far end inside a morning greenhouse. Broad leaves move gently in the ventilation.

A fixed wide shot looks through an open entrance onto a long planting table along the center aisle, continuous plant benches along the side walls, and a watering station at the far end inside a morning greenhouse. A broad opaque greenhouse shade slowly closes across the entrance until the room is fully hidden, leaving only the empty entrance platform in view.

A fixed wide shot holds on the empty entrance platform. A broad opaque greenhouse shade slowly opens, revealing a long planting table along the center aisle, continuous plant benches along the side walls, and a watering station at the far end inside a morning greenhouse.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 宽大的不透明温室遮帘缓慢合拢并遮住温室内部，画面只留下入口平台
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 温室外侧的空入口平台
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 温室遮帘缓慢打开，重新露出完整温室布局
transition_design.design_note_zh: Scene/layout 无法自行离场，因此 Shot 2 用自然遮挡结构缓慢关闭，Shot 3 用对应开启动作重新露出整体布局。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
